# Layout of the rdma-core mirrors in bytes: "<C type> <size>" and
# "<C type>.<member> <offset> <size>"; "<member>@<GOARCH>" holds on that
# architecture, and a negative offset counts back from the member a
# mirror ends at. Regenerate with go test -update once TestLayoutsMatchC
# passes.
